tool_args.rationale: The fixed-gradient input series is increasing and concave, while the acquired low/high sink-gradient pair shows strong inhibition. Fit the two-layer siphon form with its open square-root branch coefficient estimated numerically; the failed prior execution was due to an undefined training-data global, corrected by using fit(train_rows) to set model parameters.

considered_alternatives.rejected_reason: Already acquired; the two additional rows provide substantial sink-gradient variation and distinguish the branch response.
All observations share H and the observed direct input-saturation plus gradient effect supports the siphon bridge; no trajectory evidence requires the more expensive ODE fit.
These alternatives cannot explain both the concave response and the large dependence on s_grad.
The numeric fit leaves the branch coefficient free in sign, allowing the observations to select it without a separate probe.
